nativeExceptions.name: original-caller-authority
nativeExceptions.reason: Actual Node removes every matching source/target without per-record owner binding. Native requires the original caller, pinned workspace/base, private owner-bound deleted card and private owner-bound edge/peers. A request principal does not replace the original operator. Blocked matching edges remain byte-identical and contribute one cleanup error.
nativeExceptions.cost: Directory/policy checks and bounded source reads, repeated Lance row fingerprints before publication.

nativeExceptions.name: opaque-byte-preservation
nativeExceptions.reason: Actual Node drops blank lines and completes a partial tail when rewriting. Native preserves every retained byte, including malformed, incomplete and duplicate-key records; only complete unambiguous string-ID records are eligible. No numeric-ID coercion.
nativeExceptions.cost: 64 MiB/50000 physical-line limit; no append retention/cap during shrinking cleanup.

nativeExceptions.name: source-and-lease-fencing
nativeExceptions.reason: Native retains the original file descriptor, source identity/digest and exact bytes; rechecks caller, config, policy, import lease and row fingerprints before private synced replacement. Failures after card rollback are reported for retry, without undoing the completed rollback.
nativeExceptions.cost: Private staging and extra I/O; no atomic CAS against a noncooperating writer after the final check.

boundaries: Canonical graph only, as in Node; legacy aliases are not modified.
Vault mirror authority remains F14, no migration of ownerless approvals.
Three recorded Node vectors are exercised with explicit native ownership stamping; remaining recorded anomalies are retained as reference and covered by separate native refusal/preservation tests.
Frozen agent-private import rows lack user/workspace evidence. Their graph cleanup reports failure and preserves edges; edge stamping cannot invent row authority. No import binding change is implied.
